    {"name": "improvement_target_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.97, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Categorizes the nature of the target (cost/time/satisfaction/volume/rate), a useful cross-cutting axis for comparing goals. Values are cleanly derivable from the described verbs and metrics in each row."},
    {"name": "target_metric_alignment", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Flags whether the goal's intent matches the assigned metric column, a genuinely useful analytic axis given the visibly mismatched metrics (e.g. Customer Satisfaction goal with 'Expense Ratio', Revenue goal with 'Survey Score'). Judgments in samples correctly read as misaligned; grounded in comparing description vs metric."},
    {"name": "target_scope", "analytical_usefulness": 0.78, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "A thematic domain axis (efficiency, revenue, customer/employee experience, cost). Partially overlaps with category but offers a normalized grouping usable across departments. Values are sound extractions from descriptions."},
    {"name": "stakeholder_impact_span", "analytical_usefulness": 0.72, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Adds a stakeholder-reach dimension distinct from scope; useful for cross-comparison. Mostly a warranted inference, though somewhat correlated with target_scope, and some assignments (e.g. cross_organizational for a subscription-volume goal) are looser inferences."},
    {"name": "risk_or_dependency_indicator", "analytical_usefulness": 0.45, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Heavily skewed (459 true / 91 false) making it near-constant and low-leverage. Grounding is weak: several sample rows contain no explicit risk/dependency yet are marked True, suggesting the flag is over-asserted beyond textual support."},
    {"name": "comparison_baseline", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.78, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Baseline of comparison is analytically valuable for interpreting targets. Grounded when text is explicit ('compared to last quarter', 'fiscal year'), but some samples introduce a specific baseline the text does not state (e.g. 'current_baseline' assigned where no baseline is mentioned rather than NULL), a mild over-specification."},
    {"name": "temporal_scope_window", "analytical_usefulness": 0.82, "source_groundedness": 0.72, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Timeframe is a useful axis and often grounded ('by end of Q4' -> next_quarter/6_months, 'next fiscal year'). However some mappings are inconsistent or unsupported (e.g. 'upcoming year' -> next_2_years is contradicted by the text; Q4 -> next_6_months vs next_quarter inconsistency), indicating some invented specificity."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.79,
  "source_groundedness": 0.81,
  "rationale": "The added columns collectively open several genuine new axes (management practice, target type, metric alignment, scope, stakeholder span, baseline, timeframe) that map well onto the query's department/metric/practice comparison and are mostly well-grounded extractions or warranted inferences from the descriptions. The metric-alignment column is especially valuable given the visibly mismatched metric assignments. Weaknesses: risk_or_dependency_indicator is near-constant and over-asserted, and comparison_baseline / temporal_scope_window occasionally invent specifics the text does not support instead of using unknown values."
}
